prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a small house in a white terraced port town on sea cliffs. Flat teal-blue roof. White-washed plaster walls with blue window frames and doors, arched windows. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 176 x 160 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.

Roof seen from above, front elevation wall seen head-on, rectangular flat-roofed 3/4 top-down JRPG map building, never show sides of building or change proportions. Replace magenta with FULL TRANSPARENCY, including entire empty top margin. No ground or drop shadow. A small whitewashed terraced sea-cliff port town house: flat teal-blue roof surface with subtle pixel-cluster patina and thin eaves; cream-white plaster facade with blue frames around two windows, gently arched openings WITHIN each preexisting rectangular window footprint and warm amber glazing; dark deep-blue painted door WITHIN the same guide door rectangle, preserve door exactly as a usable dark ground-level doorway. Details optional subtle plaster pixels, teal roof tile or seams, small blue door latch and trim, no extra windows. Premium cohesive hand-placed hi-bit pixel art JRPG sprite, every pixel exactly the same sharp 7x7 screen pixels, nearest-neighbor edges, intentional clusters of 3–10 art pixels, limited hue-shifted palettes 4–6 shades per material, purple-red saturated shadow tones and yellow-warm highlight tones. Soft uniform neutral overcast evening upper-left light, glazing alone amber, no cast shadow, no light pools, no vignette, no night treatment. No blur, antialiasing, noise, photographic texture, dithering, text, people, terrain, or background. Precisely match guide's existing outer silhouette and arrangement; do not recenter or rescale.
